user.title: ViewSonic Projector
user.description: Enter the address of the ESPHome serial bridge attached to the projector's RS-232 port.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESPHome bridge node.
data_description.port: TCP port configured under stream_server on the bridge.
data_description.name: Name for the projector device in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge, or the projector did not answer. Check that the bridge is online, that the projector is plugged into mains power, and that TX/RX are not swapped.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Power is read every cycle. Other settings rotate through a queue a few per cycle, so a full refresh takes roughly ten cycles.

data_description.scan_interval: Lower is more responsive but puts more traffic on the serial line. 3 seconds suits most setups.
